stories.title: Jio Platforms launches Rs 30,213 crore IPO, valued at over Rs 10 lakh crore
stories.summary: Jio Platforms announced a public offering of shares with an issue size of Rs 30,213 crore, valuing the company at more than Rs 10 lakh crore. The offering is described as the biggest public issue ever in India. The announcement includes details on IPO dates, price band and the GMP for investors.
stories.why: The scale of the IPO could set new benchmarks for capital raising in Indian markets.

stories.title: Jio Platforms holds press conference ahead of IPO, Ambani siblings discuss growth and market share
stories.summary: Jio Platforms convened a press conference before its upcoming IPO, where Akash and Isha Ambani spoke to the media about the company's growth plans, financial discipline and market position. Isha Ambani said the firm’s motto is “Growth is life” and that financial prudence is part of its DNA, while Akash Ambani noted Jio carries about 60 % of India’s data traffic.
stories.why: The remarks give investors insight into Jio’s strategic focus and dominant market share ahead of the offering.

stories.title: India's unemployment rate stays steady at 5% in September
stories.summary: India's overall unemployment rate held steady at 5.0% in September 2026, compared to the previous month. The rural unemployment rate improved to 4.2%, while urban unemployment increased slightly to 6.9%.
stories.why: This matters because it can affect economic growth, prices, employment, borrowing costs or trade decisions.
stories.previousTitle: India’s unemployment rate steady at 5% in September 2026
stories.previousSummary: India’s overall unemployment rate held steady at 5.0% in September 2026, unchanged from the previous month. Rural unemployment fell to 4.2%, while urban unemployment rose slightly to 6.9% and urban female unemployment increased to 9.2%; the Labour Force Participation Rate rose to 55.5% year‑on‑year and the Worker Population Ratio climbed to 52.7%.

stories.title: Seven crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
stories.summary: A search and rescue operation involving boats and helicopters is now continuing in rough seas, Romania's authorities say Seven of 12 crew members are missing after a drone attack left a chemical tanker ablaze off Romania's coast on Thursday morning, naval authorities say. Romanian President Nicușor Dan confirmed that the Wine Trader and another chemical tanker in the area, the Yara J, had both been struck by drones - the Yara J on Wednesday.

stories.title: School headscarf ban sparks rare protests in Azerbaijan and row with Turkey
stories.summary: "You are telling me, I can't come to school?" says a teenage girl in a navy blue Islamic headscarf, captured on video challenging a staff member at the entrance to her school. The footage has been shared widely on social media, and shows a group of girls in hijabs standing behind her applauding as she continues: "Why should I have to give up my religion?" Last Monday the education ministry in Azerbaijan began enforcing new uniform rules, turning away female pupils wearing hijabs.

stories.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
stories.summary: Meta has launched what it calls the “most capable” open-weight model in the United States. The new model, which leverages 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, claims to offer superior performance to other popular open-weight models, according to evaluation results released by Meta on Thursday.
